key_stat: Part of Crédit Agricole Group | €4.6T AUC | Fund admin, custody, clearing
summary: CACEIS is a major European asset servicing company, subsidiary of Crédit Agricole Group. €4.6T AUC. Provides custody, fund administration, clearing, middle-office outsourcing, and transfer agency services. Key European competitor to BNY, State Street, and Northern Trust. Acquired KAS BANK and RBC Investor Services. Growing through M&A and organic. Technology modernisation needed to compete with US custodians.
